name: magnum
listed_description: Lightweight and modular C++11/C++14 graphics middleware for games and data visualization.
reason: README has no benchmark. Magnum and Corrade changelogs (doc/changelog.dox, corrade-changelog.dox) contain only qualitative 'faster' remarks (std::strtoull alternatives, normal matrix) and one self-comparison (TextureTools::DistanceField 60% of previous time); no numbers against a named external baseline. No third-party shootout found.

name: micro-gl
listed_description: Realtime, Embeddable, Headers Only C++11 CPU vector graphics. no STD lib, no FPU and no GPU required.
reason: README calls it Fast and Super Slim but gives no timings; notes/ folder holds design notes only (clipping, gradient, path, tessellation, rasterizer versions); no comparison against Skia, AGG, Blend2D or Cairo anywhere in the repo.

name: Ogre 3D
listed_description: A scene-oriented, real-time, flexible 3D rendering engine (as opposed to a game engine) written in C++.
reason: OGRE README says 'High-Performance Rendering Backend' with no numbers; ogre-next README describes data-oriented design with no numbers; ogre3d.org (2.1 FAQ) blocked in this session; only anecdotal forum FPS posts (Irrlicht forum, circa 2006-2008) surfaced in search, not openable and not a controlled benchmark.

name: oof
listed_description: Convenient, high-performance RGB color and position control for console output.
reason: README only advises batching output and notes that printf and std::cout are slow on Windows (directional claim, no numbers); tests/ and demos/ contain no timing comparisons; no shootout against rang, termcolor or raw ANSI escapes found.

name: OpenGL
listed_description: Industry standard for high-performance graphics, with a native C binding. Various licenses.
reason: OpenGL is an API specification, not a single implementation, and has no repo of its own; opengl.org is blocked in this session. No numeric comparison of OpenGL against a named baseline exists on any reachable page; implementation-level benchmarks belong to Mesa or vendor drivers.
